filesAdded.role: assertDisposableDatabase(prisma) / assertDisposableDatabaseUrl(url) - throws DisposableDatabaseAssertionError unless the LIVE current_database() (never an env var alone) matches /^headroom_test_[a-f0-9]{8,}$/. Verified live in the adversarial test to correctly ACCEPT ephemeral databases and REJECT the real persistent `headroom` database by name.

createEphemeralDatabase(baseUrl) / destroyEphemeralDatabase(db) - full create->migrate(deploy)->use->destroy lifecycle for a per-worktree/per-process disposable Postgres database on the same server. Uses `prisma migrate deploy` exclusively (never `migrate dev`/`db push`, the tools responsible for the incident per 09).

Bounded static guard (per §17, deliberately not a full analyzer). Scans git-tracked tests/scripts/lib/app/prisma for the catastrophic empty-predicate deleteMany shapes, the ternary-collapses-to-empty-object shape, `migrate dev`/`migrate reset`/`db push` outside the one sanctioned ephemeral-db helper, and raw TRUNCATE/DROP SQL. Wired as `npm run db:check-destructive-patterns`.
